claims.text: The Jobs column overlaps and the page now says so AT the column: 23 of the 51 rows are the industry groups 325 and 326, the column sums to 54,372, and the same twelve counties hold 33,528 jobs counted once each, so 20,844 jobs appear in both a group row and a part row. The disclosure sits in the table caption (which is also the collapsed summary), in the column header, and on every row's own industry cell; the reader who found this had to reach the methodology 400 lines below to learn of it. He was right on the arithmetic: 326 is exactly 3261 + 3262 within QCEW rounding, Summit 2,486 + 1,338 = 3,824. He was wrong on the size: the column overstates by a factor of 1.62, not by roughly double, because 325 holds chemistry beyond the parts ever split out.
